_comment: The Mill on the river's NPC (content-zone-design-guide.md §2.4). Copied field for field from shepherd.json, which copied farmer.json — faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it), collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) and deliberately NOT Action(2) so no aura on either side can target it, mask 16 = Border only so nothing pushes it, role creature + speed 0 (D4: an NPC is an actor that authors no movement), xpFactor 0 to keep it off the nameplate path, aggroRadius 1.0 required-but-inert since interaction.range 2.0 is the wider of the two and sizes the one sensor. ⚑ QUESTS: offers and turns in `the-sounder-at-the-mill`, the zone's only elite fight, and `the-millers-ring`, the beach search, each behind its own root row per the Q4 tree shape. No quest_at_stage gate — a row is shown iff its ledger op would succeed (the Q1 show-rule). ⭐ HE IS THE POI'S ONE JOB: the mill is a soft dead end, so the only reason to walk down here is that someone down here asks for something. ⚑ TEACHES NOTHING, deliberately — the TownCrier/Shepherd precedent; the reward is XP and the elite's own drop table. ⛑ entityType Farmer is a DELIBERATE REUSE and placeholder art (the standing call, as for the Shepherd): a bespoke miller costs a wire enum value that can never be reclaimed plus an exhaustive client Record entry. He earns his own sprite at the Zone 1 art pass. ⚑ TEXT is plain (PO 2026-08-02): no lore or stylized wording yet. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
name: Miller

lines.text: I grind what the farm brings me, when the farm brings me anything.

options.text: Do you have a task for me?
About the boars at the mill...

lines.text: I lost my heirloom, my wedding ring, on the beach north of the farmland.
For many days I have looked for it. The thick seaweed from the last tide makes it hard to see.
Please, help me search for it before my wife takes notice.
On the beach north of the farmland. Look under the seaweed.
A sounder of boars has settled by the mill and I cannot work around them.
The big one leads them. Kill it and the rest will scatter.
It is bigger than anything else in this zone. Do not take it lightly.
Kill the big one by the mill. The rest will scatter.
